title: {NAME} is {pct}% funded
body: No ads and never will be, so {NAME} runs on the players who use it: supporters have covered {received} of the {goal} spent so far. A monthly pledge from {min} adds the supporter badge next to your name.
body-gave: Thank you for the {given} you have given. A monthly pledge from {min} is what keeps the server bill covered month after month, and it adds the supporter badge next to your name.
